cues: Their slopes multiply to minus one: the tangents are perpendicular.
Seven squared plus one squared is fifty, twice twenty five, so the point lies on the director circle, the circle from which every pair of tangents meets at a right angle.
text: Their slopes multiply to minus one: the tangents are perpendicular. That is no accident. Seven squared plus one squared is fifty, twice twenty five, so the point lies on the director circle, the circle from which every pair of tangents meets at a right angle.
